name: Emboss
description: Emboss: the picture looks pressed into metal or paper, lit from one side.

params.name: angle
params.description: Direction of the light in degrees

params.name: distance
params.description: Width of the relief edges in pixels

params.name: color
params.description: 0 is a grey relief, 1 keeps the colors

params.name: amount
params.description: Strength: 0 is the original picture, 1 the full effect
